an7.43:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
an7.43:1.3: athakho āyasmā ānando pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya kosambiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
an7.43:1.5: atippago kho tāva kosambiyaṃ piṇḍāya carituṃ
an7.43:1.6: yannūnāhaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkameyyanti.
an7.43:1.7: athakho āyasmā ānando yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodi
an7.43:1.8: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an7.43:2.1: tena kho pana samayena tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarākathā udapādi
an7.43:2.2: yo hi koci āvuso dvādasa vassāni paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati niddaso bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāyāti.
an7.43:3.1: athakho āyasmā ānando tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandi nappaṭikkosi
an7.43:3.3: bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānissāmīti
an7.43:3.4: athakho āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an7.43:4.1: idhāhaṃ bhante pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya kosambiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ
an7.43:4.3: atippago kho tāva kosambiyaṃ piṇḍāya carituṃ
an7.43:4.4: yannūnāhaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkameyyanti athakhvāhaṃ bhante yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkamiṃ upasaṅkamitvā
an7.43:4.6: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃ
an7.43:5.1: tena kho pana bhante samayena tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarākathā udapādi
an7.43:5.2: yo hi koci āvuso dvādasa vassāni paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati niddaso bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāyāti
an7.43:5.3: athakhvāhaṃ bhante tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandiṃ nappaṭikkosiṃ
an7.43:5.5: bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānissāmīti
an7.43:5.6: sakkā nu kho bhante imasmiṃ dhammavinaye kevalaṃ vassagaṇanamattena niddaso bhikkhu paññāpetunti.
an7.43:6.1: na kho ānanda sakkā imasmiṃ dhammavinaye kevalaṃ vassagaṇanamattena niddaso bhikkhu paññāpetuṃ
an7.43:6.2: satta kho imāni ānanda niddasavatthūni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditāni
an7.43:7.2: idhānanda bhikkhu saddho hoti hirīmā hoti ottappī hoti bahussuto hoti āraddhaviriyo hoti satimā hoti paññavā hoti
an7.43:7.3: imāni kho ānanda satta niddasavatthūni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditāni
an7.43:7.4: imehi kho ānanda sattahi niddasavatthūhi samannāgato bhikkhu dvādasa cepi vassāni paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati niddaso bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya
an7.43:7.5: catuvīsati cepi vassāni paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati niddaso bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya
an7.43:7.6: chattiṃsati cepi vassāni paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati niddaso bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāya aṭṭhacattāḷīsañcepi vassāni paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carati niddaso bhikkhūti alaṃ vacanāyāti.
